question.label: What the dashboard should answer
question.default: What moved, and by how much?

steps.title: Clean the table
steps.prompt: The CSV {{inputs.csv}} is loaded into table raw of {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite ({{steps.load.outputs.rows}} rows). Make a clean table: fix types, duplicates, date and price formats and blank categories. Do not edit the CSV. List every change in {{run.dir}}/CLEANING.md.

steps.title: Check against the source
steps.prompt: Compare table {{steps.clean.outputs.table}} in {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite with table raw and {{inputs.csv}}: row counts, column totals, nulls. Set passed to false when any total is more than 0.5% off. Write the comparison to {{run.dir}}/QA.md.

steps.title: Pick KPIs and charts
steps.prompt:
Question: {{inputs.question}}

From table {{steps.clean.outputs.table}} in {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite, pick 5 KPIs and one chart form each. Write {{run.dir}}/DASHBOARD.md with each KPI's SQL and its expected headline value.

steps.title: Build the dashboard
steps.prompt: Build {{run.dir}}/dashboard.html from {{run.dir}}/DASHBOARD.md and {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite: one self-contained page, every headline and chart from the SQL in DASHBOARD.md. If {{run.dir}}/READBACK.md lists wrong headlines, fix those.

steps.title: Read the numbers back
steps.prompt: dashboard.html is open in your browser pane. Read each headline off the page and compare it with the expected value in {{run.dir}}/DASHBOARD.md. Write {{run.dir}}/READBACK.md listing each headline, page value, expected value, match or not. Set verdict to pass when every headline matches, otherwise wrong.

steps.title: Write what moved
steps.prompt:
Question: {{inputs.question}}

Using {{run.dir}}/DASHBOARD.md and {{run.dir}}/data.sqlite, write {{run.dir}}/SUMMARY.md: what moved and by how much, with the working shown step by step with the real numbers.

steps.title: Check the numbers, then Continue
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/SUMMARY.md and {{run.dir}}/dashboard.html. Continue signs off; reject cancels the run. Sending the summary is yours.
